Sam K.: Vendor pentest confirmed 2027-01-18 -> 2027-01-20 against staging (HSM-backed KMS). Need RBAC freeze window, evidence upload flow, log capture plan, redaction sign-off, and a single remediation + retest tracker.

Ben I.: I'll own the KMS/HSM side. No direct HSM keys shared. Plan: vendor uploads encrypted bundle to `pt-evidence-hsm` via presigned PUTs. Require encryption-context purpose=pt-evidence. TTL 2h.

Ben I.: Presign example: `aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence-hsm/staging-20270118.tgz --expires-in 7200` and require header `x-amz-meta-purpose: pt-evidence`.

Deepa P.: RBAC: ephemeral role `pt_assessor_hsm` with external-id + MFA. Session policy read-only, explicit deny for `ec2:RunInstances` and `iam:*`. No SSH allowed; provide recorded bastion playback if they need shell. Revoke role 24h after window.

Marta L.: I'll run the remediation tracker and retest scheduling. Proposed retest weeks: 2027-01-25 or 2027-02-01. I'll create GH project and a 30m weekly sync post-test.

Sam K.: Legal insists on automated scrub + manual review. Redaction checklist: remove PII, user IDs, internal tokens, long-lived API keys. Legal sign-off required before external transfer.

Ben I.: KMS policy snippet (concept): allow decrypt only when `kms:EncryptionContext:purpose` == `pt-evidence` and principal == pt_assessor role. We'll refine for prod.

Deepa P.: Runbook short: 1) Create ephemeral role per vendor. 2) Issue presigned PUTs with required meta headers. 3) Capture CloudTrail + app logs (15m before -> 45m after). 4) Run `log-scrub --preview` and manual redaction if hits. 5) Revoke role and rotate temp creds. 6) If active exploit observed, pause test and escalate oncall + security lead.

ops-bot: staging snapshot created: snap-351800-20270117 (id: snap-351800).

Marta L.: Assignments recap: Ben -> KMS/presign doc; Deepa -> RBAC runbook + teardown; Marta -> remediation tracker + retest calendar; Sam -> ops checklist and legal handoff. Add availability to the invite. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
